meta.title: White Paper · AI Data Center
meta.description: AI DC White Paper: online preview and download of version 1.0.

page.intro1: AI data centers (AI DC) have become a focal point across the industry. Planning and construction urgently need a comprehensive, systematic framework. Working with the industry, we have drawn on years of in-depth research, innovations in key products and solutions, and extensive exploration and build-out practice. More than twenty experts contributed their expertise; we integrated statistics from international organizations and findings from industry research institutions, and continued to refine the work through a dozen workshops and exchanges. The result is this white paper with significant reference value.
page.intro2: We hope this white paper helps the industry move steadily forward on the path of digital and intelligent transformation—building powerful, solid intelligent computing data centers that enable every sector to reach a more efficient, more intelligent future.
